network: Ephemeral 127.0.0.1 only; fake upstream/transcriber; external fetch disabled
measurement: One workflow per scheduled client, not users. Server and HTTP load generator share this process. RPS includes failures and drain time. Page graph includes all declared CSS fonts and runtime mascots; other JavaScript-created images and lazy imports excluded. No JavaScript execution. Static assets primed before timing. Screenshots use one tiny synthetic JPEG data URL, not max-size images.
workload: Each client repeats sequential workflows, up to iterationsPerClient (0 = unlimited). First starts are scheduled at phase start + clientIndex/clients * ramp, independently in warmup and measurement. No workflow admission after the shared phase deadline or iteration budget; admitted workflows drain. Client-limited phases may finish before admissionWindowMs. Rates include ramp and drain. maxSockets is per origin, shared by all clients.

timingDefinitions.agentQueue: Request creation to socket assignment; includes Agent queue and scheduling delay.
timingDefinitions.tcpConnect: Socket assignment to connect event for connecting TCP sockets; includes DNS when using localhost. Failed connections have no sample.
timingDefinitions.newSocketTtfb: Request creation to response headers on a newly observed physical socket; includes queue/connect, not first body byte.
timingDefinitions.reusedSocketTtfb: Request creation to response headers on a previously observed physical socket, including preflight/warmup sockets; includes queue.
timingDefinitions.bodyRead: Response headers to complete response body; only responses reaching end have samples.
timingDefinitions.connections: Measured request socket assignments, split by new/reused physical socket; not concurrent connections. Requests aborted before assignment are excluded.
timingDefinitions.histograms: Counts of observed events; 0.1ms buckets plus overflow at timeoutMs + 0.1ms, exact maxMs. Errors may lack later events. No timing histograms/listeners when timing=false.

capacity: Injected settings; older apps may ignore them. Quota limiters bypassed. 503 is reported separately.
journalStorage: temporary SQLite WAL; generated RSA-2048 key; deleted on exit
